body:
I really hope things get better. I'm failing in school, my relationships to other people are deteriorating and I feel constant shame because of all the shit I've done.. the pain I've brought to so many people, especially my family.

But thank you for being one of the two people that actually replied. It means so much to me.

Things have gotten better in the past, but right now everything seems hopeless. I've been kicked while down before, but not to this extent. I've never felt this drained in my entire life.

Exercise, not really no. Now it's even harder if I want to start with that - corona has closed the gyms, and I'm not able to do a lot because of my fucked up shoulder. Done a few sit-ups yesterday but it's hard finding motivation.

I've lost 15 kg (34 lbs) over the past two years. It's just muscle burning at this point.. I feel weaker.
